name: app-check-ai-gate-wire
description: AI Logic generateContent from Node in the ai-probes request shape (GoogleAI backend, gemini-flash-lite-latest) with no X-Firebase-AppCheck header, a malformed header, the web SDK placeholder token, an Admin-minted token with one signature character changed, and a valid Admin-minted token. The enforcementMode read for firebaseml.googleapis.com just before the capture is recorded in behavior.
